items.title: [bug] Text migration resume after a crash that dropped rows leaves manifest counts stale (included_rows, rejections)
items.ownership_note: Open, non-draft PR #164 ('Closes #160', author NoeFlandre, branch fix/issue-160-resume-manifest-counts at bfa71c0, mergeable_state clean when read). Issue has no comments.

criteria.text: Resume after a crash that dropped rows records the dropped rows in included_rows and rejections['no_nonempty_description'] (issue reproduction)
criteria.evidence: Main ea22740 dataset/text_migration.py: _migrate_one_artifact calls _heal_output_identity when the Parquet is already canonical, and that function only refreshes manifest.output. PR #164 replaces it with _heal_interrupted_repair (dropped = included_rows minus Parquet row count, written through the shared _repaired_manifest) and adds test_resume_after_a_crash_that_dropped_rows_records_the_drop. Met in the PR, not on main.

criteria.text: validate_finalized_artifacts compares included_rows with the Parquet row count (suggested fix, phrased as 'should also')
criteria.evidence: PR #164 does not touch the storage-level validator. The CLI validate path already checks this on main: cli.py _validate_artifact_pair calls _validate_manifest_row_count, which raises when manifest included_rows differs from Parquet rows. So the issue's claim that validation does not notice holds only for validate_finalized_artifacts.

linked_prs.relation: closes #160; resume-path count fix plus regression test

items.closure_evidence: None yet. Close after PR #164 merges with its test green on CI.
items.remaining_requirement: None beyond merging #164. Optional hardening (count check inside validate_finalized_artifacts) is not in #164 and is not required by the bug text.
code_evidence: main ea22740 src/osm_polygon_description_tag/dataset/text_migration.py: _heal_output_identity only sets output identity
facts: Issue body reproduction and file/function names match main ea22740.
PR #164 body: just check passed locally; just risk and mutation-scope not run.
PR #164 has one Codex summary comment (review completed at bfa71c0, no findings text).
inferences: PR #164 and PR #166 both insert a line at the top of the Fixed section in CHANGELOG.md, so the second one to merge will conflict.
PR #164 and PR #168 both edit text_migration.py near lines 221-226, which is a probable textual conflict.
items.uncertainty: I did not run the reproduction test. The storage-level behaviour described in the issue (validate_finalized_artifacts returns normally) was not executed.

criteria.text: Staging directory is removed when _stage_changes raises or the process is interrupted before any state references it
criteria.evidence: Main ea22740 deduplicate_dataset calls _stage_changes directly with no cleanup (the PR #166 diff base shows the same code). PR #166 adds _stage_changes_or_discard, which catches BaseException, runs shutil.rmtree(stage_root, ignore_errors=True) and re-raises. Met in the PR.

criteria.text: Resumable staged state is not removed
criteria.evidence: Design: the PR only cleans before a state file is written, so a 'staged' state still resumes. Tests added cover failure without a state file, not resume after a staged state.

criteria.text: Optional: remove unreferenced .work/dedup/* directories at the start of deduplicate_dataset
criteria.evidence: Not in PR #166. The issue marks it optional.

criteria.text: The card and image are generated from the enriched polygon rows.
criteria.evidence: shard_processing._enrich_geometry_shard passes observe=options.card.observe to transform.append_label_sidecar, so every output row feeds the accumulator. cards.DatasetCardAccumulator.write_artifacts writes README.md and eunis/world-map.svg. card_publishing._finalize_plan wires the card into finalize_dataset.

criteria.text: The map is static.
criteria.evidence: cards._render_map writes a self-contained SVG with no scripts and fixed layout constants (_MapLayout).

criteria.text: The map is deterministic.
criteria.evidence: Bins and summaries are sorted (_point_elements, summaries). A golden-hash test pins the README and SVG bytes (commit a65ffe96, PR 24, per its message).

criteria.text: The map includes a clear label/color key.
criteria.evidence: cards._legend_elements draws only summaries[:18] and then '+ N more in the table'. The 'No EUNIS label' entry sorts last (summaries sorts code None last), so it is the first to be dropped, yet its grey points stay on the map. cards._label_colors assigns _PALETTE[index % len(_PALETTE)] with a 20-entry palette, so coded label 21 onward reuses an earlier colour. The key is incomplete above 18 labels and ambiguous above 20.

criteria.text: The table includes every EUNIS label and the unlabeled percentage.
criteria.evidence: cards._render_readme builds the 'Label distribution' table from summaries(), including every code and the None row 'No EUNIS label', with the share to two decimals.

items.closure_evidence: None.

criteria.text: Separate recognition misses, absent gold candidates, wrong ranking and abstentions.

criteria.evidence: Not found in the files read. scripts/benchmark/runner.py, compare.py and report.py were listed but not read. No cost estimator was seen.

criteria.text: Evaluate actual configured similarity thresholds, not only gold-span threshold-0 history.

criteria.text: Publish a reproducible decision report after separate execution/publication approval; no automatic production rollout or fine-tuning.
criteria.evidence: Gated by the issue boundaries. No decision report exists.

criteria.text: Tests prevent gold-span leakage, silent skipped languages and mixed run provenance.
criteria.evidence: PR #171 body says it rejects mixed model/custom-code pins and mismatched eligible counts (unmerged). Main tests were not inspected.

items.title: [benchmark] Freeze a fair public-benchmark comparison protocol
items.ownership_note: Closed-by reference: PR #171 'Freeze the public benchmark comparison protocol' (open, not draft, body says 'Closes #160', head feat/benchmark-protocol-160 at 871801b9b13ef3b6bab7416a26fc59082b39eb61, base main fe84a62). No issue comments (get_comments returned none).

criteria.text: Versioned experiment schema records model revision, label mapping, thresholds, source split, hardware, batch size, warm/cold timing, memory, seeds and invalid-output handling

criteria.evidence: PR 171 docs/guides/benchmark-protocol.md sections 'Keep the tasks separate' (exact ID, 1/10/50 km inclusive, coverage, abstention, candidate recall) and 'Aggregate and quantify uncertainty' (equal-language macro, pooled micro, marginal stratified document bootstrap 95 percent). scripts/benchmark_protocol/summary.py exists at 871801b; not read.
